def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    groups = []
    unseen = set(cells)
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        stack = [start]
        group = [start]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                p = (r+dr, c+dc)
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p)
                    stack.append(p)
                    group.append(p)
        groups.append(group)
    tile_group = None
    for group in groups:
        colors = {grid[r][c] for r, c in group}
        if len(colors) > 1:
            tile_group = group
            break
    r0 = min(r for r, c in tile_group)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in tile_group)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in tile_group)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in tile_group)
    tile = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    n = len(tile)
    row = [v for _ in range(n) for line in tile for v in []]
    output = []
    for _ in range(n):
        for line in tile:
            output.append(line * n)
    return output

        group = [start]

            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):

    boxes = []

        c0 = min(c for r, c in group)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in group)
